fieldNotes.blanks: An explicit state object records unpublished, inapplicable, or unverified values. Numeric, boolean and categorical estimates are labeled in estimatedFields. Preserve those labels when importing to the matcher.
fieldNotes.description: The source has no prose descriptions. The starter descriptions summarize available listing facts or titles. Replace or expand them with confirmed details.
fieldNotes.address: Residential entrances are approximate address points. Grouped properties may use a community-center address. Check addressRole and estimatedFields before routing.
fieldNotes.commute: Confirm residentialEntrance coordinates for the apartment. The app calculates commute time to each student’s pin by travel mode. The imported property coordinates are a reference for locating the entrance.
fieldNotes.requirements: Values apply to the listed floor plan or room unless a specific offer includes a confirmed requirement override. Apartment size is total apartment square footage. Room area is recorded separately when the title identifies a room listing. Bedroom occupancy counts people in one bedroom. Private bathroom means assigned exclusively to that renter.
fieldNotes.propertyFactors: Imported flags and estimates apply at property level in the source export. Check applicability and evidence before using a flag for a specific floor plan or offer.
fieldNotes.price: Monthly rent, fees and totals are in USD per person. Imported amounts are used without dividing by occupants. The original quote preserves archived source data. Explicit conflicts about billing basis need confirmation. Verified totals cover published fixed mandatory fees. Use estimated totals as planning figures.
fieldNotes.offers: Use one row for each distinct offer. Add its roomOption and requirementOverrides when access, privacy or amenities vary. An empty offer is provided if the source had no price quote.
fieldNotes.dates: Offer dates describe listings as published. An unpublished date is an explicit state. No student move-in date was collected.
fieldNotes.unassignedPrices: An unassigned price is a building-wide quote without a verified floor-plan match. State entries indicate a property has no unassigned price.
fieldNotes.viewUrl: Every plan links to available plan media, a group of floor plans or a listing. floorPlanUrlRole identifies when floorPlanUrl falls back to viewUrl.
fieldNotes.firecrawl: Firecrawl updates include source evidence on applicable fields and offers. Advertised amounts describe the published offer as checked. Verified totals require an exact per-person monthly price covering fixed mandatory fees. Published house or graduate room-category rates without a layout link appear under advertisedUnassignedPerPersonRates. These are separate from offer prices used for filtering.
fieldNotes.groupedProperties: A floorPlans entry with listed_under_related_property points to the related site’s plan records. Exclude grouped summary records from independent recommendations.
fieldNotes.apartments: This catalog contains apartment layouts. Property type and specific layout descriptions determine eligibility.

estimationMethods.census_street_point: Exact address match to a Census street-segment geocode. The result is an approximate address point.
estimationMethods.nearby_address: Closest house number on the same normalized street with a local reference point.
estimationMethods.postal_center: Median of the imported and geocoded inventory points in the postal code, or the central Ann Arbor cohort.
estimationMethods.campus_default: Central Ann Arbor postal code approximation where street geocoding and matching neighbors were inconclusive.
estimationMethods.address_point_as_entrance: Approximate routing origin copied from the property point. Door location needs confirmation.
estimationMethods.layout_name: Derived from a bedroom, bath, or occupancy designation in the published layout title.
estimationMethods.property_peer: Reused a reported bedroom count or the most common count among published plans at this property.
estimationMethods.local_layout_comparables: Estimated from the median in the local inventory for the same home type and bedroom count, or a dimensional default when the sample is empty.
estimationMethods.published_area_midpoint: Midpoint of the published floor-area range. Actual units can differ.
estimationMethods.reported_property_factor: Provisional application of a building-level signal to a particular room, plan or policy.
estimationMethods.property_description_scope: A source mentioned this feature at the property. The exact unit or room scope remains unresolved.
estimationMethods.floor_area_share: Estimated bedroom area from total floor area after accounting for common rooms and circulation.
estimationMethods.one_person_per_bedroom_default: Assumed one renter per bedroom absent explicit occupancy information.
estimationMethods.bathroom_ratio: Provisional private-bath estimate from bedroom, bathroom and occupancy counts and the housing type.
estimationMethods.housing_type_default: Assumption based on the home type when a more specific detail is unavailable.
estimationMethods.local_heating_default: Assumed installed heating in local year-round housing; equipment and operation need confirmation.
estimationMethods.permission_unconfirmed_default: Pets are treated as unconfirmed when the source omits a species-specific policy. The provisional boolean must not be treated as a ban.
estimationMethods.included_parking_cost: No separate parking cost assumed when the source confirms the parking is part of the published terms.
estimationMethods.local_parking_comparables: Approximate cost based on the median of published parking charges in similar listings.
estimationMethods.conditional_parking_cost: No parking cost modeled if the estimated option is unavailable; this is not a quoted free space.
estimationMethods.inferred_from_parking_cost: Parking modeled as included when available with no separate charge. Check the lease.
estimationMethods.route_unconfirmed_default: A step-free route was not published. A provisional false must not be presented as a report of stairs.
estimationMethods.in_unit_laundry_route_assumption: Step-free laundry estimated from the entry route and in-unit laundry. Internal steps and equipment access can differ.
estimationMethods.inferred_layout_summary: Summary of the provisional bedroom and bath estimates.
estimationMethods.corrected_room_price_basis: The saved billing basis was contradicted by the same layout’s newer source or the listing’s explicit per-bedroom rate.
estimationMethods.imported_bed_rate: Imported per-bed rate modeled as one occupant per leased bed unless occupancy evidence says otherwise.
estimationMethods.imported_rate_review: Imported rent figure with unresolved quote scope, frequency or an occupancy-dependent range.
estimationMethods.published_charge_as_base_proxy: The published bundled charge is used as a base proxy because it has no disclosed rent breakdown.
estimationMethods.published_house_wide_rate: A published per-member house-wide charge applied provisionally to this room option.
estimationMethods.local_rent_comparables: Estimate from comparable per-person monthly rates for the property or local cohort. Comparable rates are not divided by household size.
estimationMethods.range_above_known_start: Estimated upper endpoint 12% above the starting amount. This is not a published maximum.
estimationMethods.mixed_price_range_review: Single provisional point used when the source range mixed occupancy scenarios or returned inconsistent bounds.
estimationMethods.bundled_charge_fee_assumption: No additional fixed fee modeled on top of a published bundled charge.
estimationMethods.comparable_fixed_fees: Median fixed recurring fees from available comparable quotes, with a $35 planning assumption where no comparison exists.
estimationMethods.published_starting_total: Advertised total treated as a budget estimate because the final offer can differ.
estimationMethods.base_plus_estimated_fees: Per-person base estimate plus fixed-fee estimate.
estimationMethods.layout_label_as_option: Layout label used for a quote that does not identify a more specific room or unit.
estimationMethods.listed_accessible_entry: The listing identifies an accessible entry for this apartment. The full step-free route still requires confirmation.
estimationMethods.remaining_layout_combinations: The listing identifies the available bedroom counts. The exact variant for this unit was estimated using the other documented unit types and pricing.
estimationMethods.imported_per_person_rate: The imported monthly amount is treated as a per-person rate without a household split. Confirm the current rate and billing basis on the listing.
